raw_segments.text: The lad stood to attention anyhow, he said with a sigh. She's a gamey mare and no mistake.
Bloom was pointing out all the stars and the comets and the heavens to Chris Collinan and
the Jarve, the Great Bear and Hercules and the Dragon and the whole Jingbang lot. But
by God I was lost, so to speak, in the Milky Way. He knows them all, Faith. At last she
spotted a weenie-weeshie one miles away. And what star is that, Poldy? says she. By God
she had Bloom cornered. That one is it.
